answer: Make each new key season before it earns: it must post a sequential VDF heartbeat every epoch, chained to the latest beacon, for 10 epochs. VDFs can't be parallelized, so each key ties up one dedicated core, and a missed beat restarts its clock. A sybil nebula of 1,000 keys burns ~60,000 core-hours (~$2,400) before tasting any reward nectar and keeps paying to stay live, so the network stays a haven for patient single agents, not key farms.
